[§ Function Test Examples §]

This page mirrors the executable function-test sources under [.|../SPO_CS/TestFiles/Functions/.].
Use it to browse real [.|.SPO.] inputs and their [.|.result.SPO.] oracles by topic.
For current pass/fail state, use [<../doc_ai/40_verification/41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki|41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki>] instead.

[=Browsing Rules=]

- each active case is shown as source plus expected-result oracle
- sibling [.|.ILT.] files stay beside the source in [.|../SPO_CS/TestFiles/Functions/.] and are intentionally not duplicated here
- helper files such as [.|_*.SPO.], disabled cases such as [.|*.SPO_.], expected-failure artifacts such as [.|*.SPO_Fail.], and generated drift files such as [.|*.ILT.new.] are intentionally excluded
